description: This file defines functions and types related to temporal decay calculations for memory entries, including parsing memory dates from file paths, computing decay multipliers, and applying decay to search results based on timestamps.

methods.name: toDecayLambda
methods.description: Calculates decay rate lambda from half-life days.

methods.name: calculateTemporalDecayMultiplier
methods.description: Computes decay multiplier based on age and half-life.

methods.name: applyTemporalDecayToScore
methods.description: Applies decay multiplier to a score.

methods.name: applyTemporalDecayToHybridResults
methods.description: Applies decay to a list of results based on their timestamps.
